metadata.question: Does the GERD reservoir (Ethiopia) water level decrease in February 2022 compared to September 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: Sentinel-2 SR (10 m, 2021-2022) with GSW water occurrence band for stable water mask. Date windows: 1–30 Sep 2021 vs 1–28 Feb 2022. 2. Masking: Keep only pixels that ever had >70 % historical water (GSW) so we measure water, not cloud/land. Cloud mask S2 QA60. 3. Logic: Compute median SWIR1 (B11) inside the GERD polygon; lower SWIR1 ≈ deeper water (clear look into column). Compare Sep-2021 vs Feb-2022 medians; if Feb-2022 median is higher (closer to land value) ⇒ level lower ⇒ “A”; else “B”. If any collection is empty → C1; masked pixel count ==0 → C2; result None → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') gerd = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[35.08, 11.2], [35.08, 11.4], [35.24, 11.4], [35.24, 11.2]]]) def get_col(y1, y2, m1, m2): return (ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR") .filterBounds(gerd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y1, y2, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(m1, m2, 'month')) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0)))) gsw = ee.Image("JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater").select('occurrence').gt(70) msk = lambda img: img.updateMask(gsw) col21 = get_col(2021, 2021, 9, 9).map(msk) col22 = get_col(2022, 2022, 2, 2).map(msk) s21 = col21.size().getInfo() s22 = col22.size().getInfo() if s21 == 0 or s22 == 0: print(f"Sep21 imgs: {s21}, Feb22 imgs: {s22}") print("C1") exit() def med_swir(col): img = col.median().select('B11') cnt = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), gerd, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo() val = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.median(), gerd, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo() return val, cnt v21, c21 = med_swir(col21) v22, c22 = med_swir(col22) if c21 == 0 or c22 == 0: print("Valid pix zero after mask") print("C2") exit() if v21 is None or v22 is None: print("Median calc failed") print("C3") exit() print(f"Sep21 B11: {v21:.2f} ({c21}), Feb22 B11: {v22:.2f} ({c22})") print("A" if v22 > v21 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

gerd = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
        [[[35.08, 11.2], [35.08, 11.4], [35.24, 11.4], [35.24, 11.2]]])

def get_col(y1, y2, m1, m2):
    return (ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR")
            .filterBounds(gerd)
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y1, y2, 'year'))
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(m1, m2, 'month'))
            .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0))))

gsw = ee.Image("JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater").select('occurrence').gt(70)
msk = lambda img: img.updateMask(gsw)

col21 = get_col(2021, 2021, 9, 9).map(msk)
col22 = get_col(2022, 2022, 2, 2).map(msk)

s21 = col21.size().getInfo()
s22 = col22.size().getInfo()
if s21 == 0 or s22 == 0:
    print(f"Sep21 imgs: {s21}, Feb22 imgs: {s22}")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

def med_swir(col):
    img = col.median().select('B11')
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), gerd, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo()
    val = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.median(), gerd, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo()
    return val, cnt

v21, c21 = med_swir(col21)
v22, c22 = med_swir(col22)

if c21 == 0 or c22 == 0:
    print("Valid pix zero after mask")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()
if v21 is None or v22 is None:
    print("Median calc failed")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Sep21 B11: {v21:.2f} ({c21}), Feb22 B11: {v22:.2f} ({c22})")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if v22 > v21 else "<answer>B</answer>")
